name: [🔥] Anime Expeditions
desc:
Welcome to Anime Expeditions! 🧭

🌟 Heroes from across the anime universe have banded together for the expedition of a lifetime, venturing into unknown lands filled with danger at every turn! Will you answer the call and help guide them to victory? 🌟

⚔️ Summon powerful units from your favorite anime universes!
🔥 Level Up, Evolve, and unlock devastating new abilities!
🗺️ Explore multiple Expeditions and game modes packed with challenges!
👥 Team up with friends to take down waves of enemies and towering bosses!

💠 Will you lead your team through every Expedition and become the strongest defender across all worlds?
